summary: High Frontier 4 All is Phil Eklund's uncompromisingly realistic space exploration simulation, where players design rockets from real physics-based components and navigate an actual solar-system map using delta-v costs. It's notoriously dense, rewarding careful route planning and technology investment over flashy action.
praised: unmatched scientific authenticity and educational depth
satisfying long-term tech and route planning
modular scenarios scale from beginner to expert
criticised: extremely steep learning curve and rulebook density
iconography and card text are notoriously hard to parse

interaction.kind: competing for claims, auctions, and shared board space
interaction.detail: Players bid against each other for cards and race to claim limited sites on the shared solar-system map, so territory and resource claims are contested even though each player's rocket and tech tree development happens independently.

sources: colony site VP (weighted by site multiplier/type)
scoring.how_you_win: Once an end-game trigger fires (such as a deck running out or a set number of colonies being founded), the player with the most VP from colonized sites, tech, and bonuses wins.
